name: Send on Behalf delegates
description: Lists Send on Behalf delegates across mailboxes, each resolved to an exact address and object ID or marked Unresolved.

parameters.name: Mailbox
parameters.label: Mailboxes
parameters.help: Email addresses or aliases. Leave blank to check every mailbox up to the limit.

parameters.name: MaxMailboxes
parameters.label: Maximum mailboxes
parameters.help: When no mailbox is named, stops after this many and says the result is partial.

parameters.name: MaxRows
parameters.label: Maximum rows
parameters.help: Stops after this many rows and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read recipients.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
A delegate is Resolved only when Exchange finds exactly one recipient whose name, alias, address or ID is the value it returned; a display name match, several matches or none are Unresolved.
Each distinct delegate is looked up once per run.
This is the delegate list, not effective access. Full Access and Send As are in the mailbox permissions item.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
